import urllib.request,json,hashlib,datetime
rows=[]
for name,expected in [("catalog.html","be773e3953eecc72b7dbdf9fc03ae2e9a307d18a0f1b32ea759c84da23b0bc1c"),("demo.html","c7f1877facf1c62c741373b6bd03b645ec351af3457da06c45988efde805701a")]:
 url="https://jacobmetoyer.com/RecallWeave/"+name
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache","User-Agent":"Hamon-source-receiving/1"})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as response:
  body=response.read(524289)
  assert len(body)<=524288,"Unexpectedly large public response"
  digest=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
  rows.append({"url":url,"final_url":response.url,"status":response.status,"bytes":len(body),"sha256":digest,"git_blob":hashlib.sha1(("blob "+str(len(body))+"\0").encode()+body).hexdigest(),"expected_sha256":expected,"exact":digest==expected,"content_type":response.headers.get("Content-Type"),"etag":response.headers.get("ETag")})
print(json.dumps({"checked_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"source_merge":"81363271da63c5428fcb4cafba39fc89c3557b82","rows":rows}))
assert all(row["exact"] and row["status"]==200 for row in rows),"Live source differs"
